properties.description: For all valid slash types and stakes >= minimum, slashed_amount <= stake
Slash type COORDINATED_ATTACK_CONFIRMED at 5000 bps — permanent exclusion correctly enforced
Slash type SUSTAINED_LOW_ACCURACY at 300 bps — permanent exclusion correctly not required
Slash type HARDWARE_SECURITY_FAILURE at 1000 bps — permanent exclusion correctly not required
Slash type UPTIME_FAILURE at 10 bps — permanent exclusion correctly not required
Slash type SYBIL_CLUSTER_CONFIRMED at 2500 bps — permanent exclusion correctly enforced
Slash type FALSE_COVERAGE_CLAIM_MINOR at 1000 bps — permanent exclusion correctly not required
Slash type FALSE_COVERAGE_CLAIM_MAJOR at 2500 bps — permanent exclusion correctly not required
Slash type FALSE_COVERAGE_CLAIM_CRITICAL at 5000 bps — permanent exclusion correctly not required
Slash type COORDINATION_COLLAPSE at 10000 bps — permanent exclusion correctly enforced
Slash type COVERAGE_FRAUD at 5000 bps — permanent exclusion correctly not required
Slash type SOCKPUPPET_CONFIRMED at 10000 bps — permanent exclusion correctly enforced
Slash type BTCP_SPOOF_FLAG at 500 bps — permanent exclusion correctly not required
Challenge bond equals 5% of slashed amount for all non-negative stakes
Dispute window is exactly 72 hours per whitepaper L4.9
Effective stake >= base stake for all coverage tiers (multiplier >= 1x)
UPTIME_FAILURE slash = 0.1% per day offline (10 bps * days)
SUSTAINED_LOW_ACCURACY slash = 3% per 30-day window (300 bps * windows)
